summary: XPO, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement—specifically, Amendment No. 11 to its Senior Secured Term Loan Credit Agreement. The amendment establishes a new $385 million Term B-4 loan facility, proceeds from which will refinance existing term loan B debt. Terms include a February 1, 2031 maturity, quarterly amortization at 1% of original principal per annum, and floating rate interest. The facility is secured by substantially all assets on a pari passu basis with existing credit facilities. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; no change of control, activist campaign, or strategic event is involved.
